title: VIP Robert the Doll After Dark
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Visibly intoxicated or impaired guests will be denied entry and not refunded
Tour takes place in a low-light environment
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Don't let the trolley take you for a ride. We're the only ghost tour in Key West where you'll walk the dark halls of historic Fort East Martello with authentic ghost-hunting equipment and meet Key West's infamous haunted doll, Robert. 

USA Today named us one of America's 10 Most Haunted Destinations, and Thrillist calls us "The Creepiest Place in Florida." See for yourself, but be warned: we actively engage spirits, so our hunts are not for everyone. 

We're family-owned by real Key West locals, and our Google satisfaction rating is 4.9. Our owners opened the first ghost tours on the island and wrote Ghosts of Key West, Haunted Key West, and the biography of Robert the Doll. 

Book VIP here for the two-hour ghost-hunting adventure, which includes an additional hour hunting ghosts on your own after the guided tour. (Book General Admission tickets on our site for the one-hour guided tour only).

There are dozens of ghost tours in Key West. See why people are dying to get into ours.
